name: example-fhcoc-event-flyer
title: Chamber Event Flyer
description: Printable single-page chamber event flyer: navy masthead, oversized event title, orange accent rule, date / time / venue block, ticket tiers, sponsor strip, and one call to action. Built for mixers, ribbon cuttings, Oktoberfest, the golf tournament, and State of the Town. Trigger keywords: "event flyer", "mixer flyer", "ribbon cutting", "event poster".
